newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITI says Japan low-interest policy not effective.
newsitem.headline: MITI says Japan low-interest policy not effective.

text.p: Japan's current policy of keeping interest rates low is not effective, Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) minister Shinji Sato told reporters on Friday.

"When interest rates are low, there should be an expansive effect on capital spending, but there is no such effect now," Sato said. "On the other hand, it has a dampening effect on the buying power of individuals such as pensioners, who feel that their savings are dwindling."
On Japan's economy, Sato said that the economy was still not stable, and needed the fine-tuning of policy measures.
